scope: End-to-end fixed-prefix native-code partial query-dot scoring; no center control variate or progressive stop implementation.
dataset: Cohere 1M primary1000 queries; already used for tuning, not blind

quality.rescue_meaning: patience999 prevents margin stopping within cap; explicit cap still applies

screen.points: All eligible cap64 points; if none, eligible prespecified rescue points.
screen.selection: Highest single-thread measured QPS among eligible partial points; exact ties prefer larger m then smaller cap then smaller label; freeze one candidate for all confirmations.

confirmation.interpretation: Three paired rounds are confirmation pilot, not statistical significance or breakthrough proof.

reserve.only_if: At least one thread count has positive median gain and all three positive paired gains over both baseline and full768.
reserve.scope: 1000 same-database self-excluded queries; not external IID holdout.
reserve.driver: research_benchmark_self_excluded; STOP_GRID disabled, realef800 and actual margin/patience/cap set explicitly.

breakthrough: Still requires >=25% matched-recall gain, extended repeats and additional-query checks; this protocol alone is not sufficient.
fullrotation_and_full_LUT: unchanged; only prefix correction may be added to query preparation
failure_policy: Preserve successful and failed output dirs; no overwrite or gate relaxation; corrections use new versions.
